why_text: People on insulin or sulfonylureas have a higher risk of low blood sugar, which needs safe prevention.
template_en: In the past 7 days, have you had any low blood sugar episodes (like sudden shakiness, cold sweat, hunger, or feeling faint)?
template_ur: گزشتہ 7 دنوں میں، کیا آپ کی شوگر کم (لو) ہوئی تھی (جیسے کپکپاہٹ، ٹھنڈے پسینے، شدید بھوک، یا غشی)؟
template_roman_ur: Pichle 7 dino mein, kya aap ki sugar kam (low) hui thi (jaise kapkapahat, thanday paseenay, shadeed bhook, ya ghashi)?
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician

why_text: To check if you are currently feeling symptoms of a low blood sugar.
template_en: Are you currently feeling any shakiness, sweating, dizziness, or confusion that gets better when you eat something sweet?
template_ur: کیا آپ اس وقت کپکپاہٹ، پسینہ، چکر، یا الجھن محسوس کر رہے ہیں جو میٹھا کھانے سے بہتر ہوتی ہو؟
template_roman_ur: Kya aap is waqt kapkapahat, paseena, chakkar, ya uljhan mehsoos kar rahe hain jo meetha khanay se theek hoti ho?
review_status: proposed, not reviewed by a clinician
